D.t: Greg Landsman leads by 11.1 in the forecast and wins 96% of simulations. The cushion is about 35,131 votes; a one point swing is about 1,588 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +3.0 and D +19.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.5M cash against $474K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.

R.t: Eric Conroy trails by 11.1 and wins 4% of simulations. Closing it takes about 17,566 voters switching sides, or 35,131 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +19.1 and D +3.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$474K cash against $1.5M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
